subject: SignalForge: swap assurance package — pilot credits, SLA & runtime guarantees
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@signalforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: SignalForge Purchasing <procurement@signalforge.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor swap inquiry + RFP (CloudPulse offer)

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. Quick one — we’re evaluating a potential vendor swap for inference services and just received a pricing package from CloudPulse that is materially lower on per-token economics for long-tail embeddings and long-context chat workloads.

Before we proceed further with an RFP loop, two asks: 1) can Redwood provide a price-match or structured swap package to bridge migration friction (credits / onboarding assistance)? and 2) what assurances can you provide on runtime parity for our current stack (KV cache behavior, tokenization consistency, quantized model fidelity) — these are hard requirements for our platform.

I’ve attached the RFP summary they sent (SignalForge_RFP_Attachment.pdf). We’d like to have an initial commercial response by next week and ideally a pilot window in July. If you prefer a quick call to align on scope, happy to schedule.

Best,
Alex
Alex Wu
Director, Platform Engineering — SignalForge
alex.wu@signalforge.com
procurement@signalforge.com

---
Attachment: SignalForge_RFP_Attachment.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@signalforge.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor swap inquiry + RFP (CloudPulse offer)

Thanks Alex — appreciate the context and the attachment. I read the RFP and a few initial thoughts: we can match economics at the unit level for the first 12 months via a structured credit ladder and offset your migration costs with a staged credit / onboarding bucket.

Proposed commercial highlights (high level):
- 12-week pilot: $60k in usage credits + reserved onboarding hours (solutions engineering)
- Migration credit ladder: 20% of first-quarter committed spend as an on-account credit applied over 90 days, tapering by month
- First-year commitment: additional 12% list discount on top of any committed volume pricing
- SLA & escape: a 30-day rollback window if performance/quality regressions exceed agreed thresholds (we’ll define checks below)

On runtime parity: we’ll commit to a short technical validation run (1 week) during the pilot with a shared prompt suite: performance and output-drift thresholds to be defined (we typically do: latency p95 targets, model output-regression measured by eval sets, and end-to-end KV cache correctness tests). Karthik, can you confirm the feasibility of the KV cache + quantization parity tests and an outline of what we’d need from SignalForge to run them?

I’ve attached a draft term sheet (proposed-terms-v2.docx) to capture the above and the initial SOW outline — happy to review on a call. Are you available Fri or early next week?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SignalForge: swap assurance package — pilot credits, SLA & runtime guarantees

Connor / Karthik — forwarding SignalForge’s ask and my proposed starter terms. Short bullets on the approach I want to push back with commercially and why: 

- Objective: remove cost-led objection while limiting our downside and ensuring measurable parity. We should offer a structured credit ladder (pilot credits + migration credit + first-year discount) rather than an across-the-board list price match.
- Credit ladder idea: 1) Pilot: $60k credits (12 weeks) + 40 SE hours from Redwood solutions; 2) Migration credit: 15% of Q1 committed spend as on-account credit applied over 90 days; 3) On-commit: additional 10–12% off list for the first 12 months depending on commit tier.
- SLA/escape: 30-day rollback window, with clear pass/fail on a 3-check validation: (a) latency p95 within 15% of current baseline, (b) output regressions below 3% on our evals, (c) KV cache correctness & tokenization spot-checks (we should require sample traces).
- Technical asks for parity tests (Karthik): sample request logs (anonymized), prompt set (we own), and a short sidecar harness to validate tokenization and KV cache behavior. Also need to confirm quantized-model behavior on our common long-context scenarios.

Questions for you both: can we commit to the $60k pilot + 40 SE hours? Connor, do we have the SE capacity and which team to pull? Karthik, how long to run the parity suite and can you estimate the work to create the sidecar harness? I want to keep the commercial offer time-boxed and respond to Alex by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@signalforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: SignalForge Purchasing <procurement@signalforge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalForge: swap assurance package — pilot credits, SLA & runtime guarantees

Marissa — thanks for the quick turn and for pulling together the terms. We reviewed internally. The team is generally comfortable with the structure you proposed; two items before we can sign: 

1) Need the SOW + addendum capturing the 30-day rollback & the three validation checks (we’ll define the exact eval set but want that clause explicit).
2) Procurement asked for a small performance escrow: 1-week signed performance check during pilot (we’ll run our harness in parallel). If Redwood passes, procurement issues PO and we begin.

If you can get the SOW/addendum over by EOD Thursday we’ll route for signatures. We’ll include a PO and a short note on onboarding expectations in SignalForge_PO_4231.pdf.

We’re okay with the $60k pilot credit + the migration-credit ladder and the first-year commit discount subject to the SOW language. Please include a short runbook for cutover and an ops escalation path — our infra team will want the contact points.

Schedule: preferred pilot start week of July 8th, with the one-week perf check immediately at pilot start.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this done.

Alex
Alex Wu
Director, Platform Engineering — SignalForge

procurement@signalforge.com
